description: Send an outbound message (SMS, Email, WhatsApp, GMB, IG, FB, Custom, Live_Chat).

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

contactId.description: Contact ID to send the message to

conversationId.description: Existing conversation ID to send within

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

mentions.description: Array of user IDs to mention

scheduledTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (ms) to schedule the message

type.description: Message channel type (SMS, Email, WhatsApp, GMB, IG, FB, Custom, Live_Chat)

name: crm_send_message
